observations: Photo 0: A black smartphone held in hand, front side showing a dark screen with a home button, likely an iPhone. The screen appears to have some smudges or dust, but no visible crack is evident in this shot.

Photo 1: Side view of the same phone, showing the left edge with a volume button and a power button. The casing appears to have minor scratches and wear. No visible damage to the screen from this angle.

Photo 2: Back view of the phone, clearly showing the Apple logo and the word 'iPhone' below it. The device has a dual-camera setup in the top left corner, consistent with iPhone 7 or 8 models. The back is black and shows signs of wear, including smudges and minor scratches. No visible cracks on the back glass.

read_from: photo 2 back: 'iPhone' text and dual-camera layout
